title: Abraham and the Stars
reflectionQuestion: God showed Abraham the stars to show how big his promise was. What do you love to look for up in the night sky?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Abraham & Sarah, mature tier). NIGHT-SKY WONDER. The quiet ache of being childless is named gently (a 'quiet sadness,' longing for a family) -- not dwelt on; the heart is God's starry promise + Abraham's trust. Distinct from 1852 Sarah's Promised Baby (the fulfillment/Isaac) and 1823 God Calls Abraham (the call) -- this is the promise under the stars (Gen 15). Indelible image (Adam) = 'Count the stars, Abraham... that's how big my promise is' -- kids grasp wonder before they grasp promises. 'God' throughout, no Yahweh (the name is not the point here). VOICE_DEBORAH_WISE (authoritative-kind female) -- the gravity + warmth of a covenant promise.
